goal: Add clear same-tab exits from vacation booking back to the selected business and to the site
no_applicable_lessons_reason: No accepted lesson specifically governs booking exit navigation; project product standards cover it.

requirements.statement: Add clear same-tab exits from vacation booking back to the selected business and to the site
requirements.acceptance_check: Booking shows visible back-to-business and back-to-site actions; business return preserves world, dates, guests and price in one canonical URL
evidence: Public version 238 shows both actions in the booking header and returns to the Villa Palumbo business page with the full selection.

requirements.statement: Back to business and back to site navigate in the same tab
requirements.acceptance_check: Back to business and back to site navigate in the same tab
evidence: Public DOM: both links have target=null and are inside data-keep-same-tab=true.

requirements.statement: Business return preserves world, dates, guests and price without duplicate query parameters
requirements.acceptance_check: Business return preserves world, dates, guests and price without duplicate query parameters
evidence: Public business URL contains one id, world, from, till, guests, price and illustrative parameter.

requirements.statement: Both actions are visible, non-overlapping and usable on desktop and 390px mobile
requirements.acceptance_check: Both actions are visible, non-overlapping and usable on desktop and 390px mobile
evidence: Desktop public page has no horizontal overflow; responsive CSS and mobile contract tests passed.

requirements.statement: HE EN RU FR labels are localized with correct direction and no visible Hebrew on foreign routes
requirements.acceptance_check: HE EN RU FR labels are localized with correct direction and no visible Hebrew on foreign routes
evidence: Public EN, RU and FR booking navigation is LTR, contains no Hebrew and has no overflow.

requirements.statement: Browser back returns to the real previous page when history exists
requirements.acceptance_check: Browser back returns to the real previous page when history exists
evidence: Browser history test returned from business to the exact booking URL with all original parameters.
